answer.summary: Establish a bounded inquiry to verify whether any agent memory system under stable, low-variation input conditions employs temporal smoothing or state interpolation as a proxy for implicit continuity without relying on predefined feature vectors.
answer.content: The task is to identify and document any explicit or implicit descriptions in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 of temporal smoothing or state interpolation mechanisms in memory systems where input variations are minimal and no predefined feature vectors are used. Acceptable evidence must be directly observable and non-feature-based, such as sequence-level consistency, persistence of internal states, or temporal interpolation metrics reported in the text. No assumptions beyond the source text are permitted; all claims must be traceable to explicit statements or data points in the section referenced.
